reference_sticky_contract.event_model: passive scroll listener schedules at most one requestAnimationFrame; frame callback toggles stuck state and clears ticking flag
reference_sticky_contract.change: Preserve target CSS class name but adopt source-equivalent requestAnimationFrame throttling instead of toggling on every raw scroll event.

reference_desktop_dropdown_contract.click: native button click toggles current dropdown and closes the other dropdown
reference_desktop_dropdown_contract.trigger_keydown: Only ArrowDown is special: preventDefault, open, focus first panel link. Enter and Space are left to native button activation/click behavior.
panel_keydown: Escape closes all dropdowns and focuses the trigger.
ArrowDown and ArrowUp operate only when document.activeElement is a panel link.
ArrowUp from the first link focuses the trigger.
ArrowDown from the last link remains on the last link.
No Home/End behavior is added because the reference header script does not implement it.

current_route_state.popup_button: Do not add aria-current to the popup trigger itself.
normalization: Resolve items with new URL(item[1], window.location.origin).
Normalize /foo and /foo/ as equal, keep root '/'.
